headline: Man arrested for helping shooters escape after shooting of criminal 'Kailla Palash'
summary: Police arrested Imam Hussain, who admitted to facilitating the 'safe exit' of attackers who shot listed criminal Yasin Khan Palash, also known as 'Kailla Palash'.
details: Police have arrested Imam Hussain in connection with the shooting of Yasin Khan Palash, alias 'Kailla Palash', a listed criminal in Dhaka's Rampura area.

headline: Actor's husband sent to jail over wife's death after remand
summary: Safiullah, accused of inciting actress Asma Akter Jhilik's suicide, has been sent to prison by a Dhaka court following a one-day remand.
details: A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has ordered that Safiullah, alias Mohabbat, be sent to jail after completing his one-day remand.
Safiullah is accused of inciting actress Asma Akter Jhilik's suicide. She died after falling from the 8th floor of a hospital in Dhanmondi, Dhaka.
The investigation officer from Dhanmondi Model Police Station stated that the accused provided important information during interrogation, but further verification is needed.
The police requested the court to keep the accused in custody to prevent any disruption to the ongoing investigation.
According to the case, Asma Akter was caring for her husband, who had been admitted to Bangladesh Medical College Hospital for stomach pain.
On June 12, around 1:00 PM, Asma had a video call with her younger sister. About an hour later, the husband informed her father that Asma had fallen from the open balcony of the cabin's window.
Following the incident, Asma's elder brother, Mozammel Haq, filed a case of incitement to suicide against Safiullah on Saturday.
Safiullah was arrested on the same day and was subsequently granted a one-day remand by the court.
caption:
An actor's husband is behind bars after his wife fell from a hospital balcony. Was it suicide or something more?

A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has ordered that Safiullah, alias Mohabbat, be sent to jail after completing his one-day remand.

Safiullah is accused of inciting actress Asma Akter Jhilik's suicide. She died after falling from the 8th floor of a hospital in Dhanmondi, Dhaka.

The investigation officer from Dhanmondi Model Police Station stated that the accused provided important information during interrogation, but further verification is needed.

The police requested the court to keep the accused in custody to prevent any disruption to the ongoing investigation.

According to the case, Asma Akter was caring for her husband, who had been admitted to Bangladesh Medical College Hospital for stomach pain.

On June 12, around 1:00 PM, Asma had a video call with her younger sister. About an hour later, the husband informed her father that Asma had fallen from the open balcony of the cabin's window.

Following the incident, Asma's elder brother, Mozammel Haq, filed a case of incitement to suicide against Safiullah on Saturday.

Safiullah was arrested on the same day and was subsequently granted a one-day remand by the court.

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News
